spans.s: mf(आ)n. (fr. श्येन-पात) any place fit for the flying of hawks (= श्येन-पातो ऽस्याम् वर्तते; with मृगया f. ‘hawking, hunting with hawks’), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 58, Sch.
relating or belonging to the Ekāha Śyena, PañcavBr., Sch.
descended from a white cow, MaitrS.

cl. 1. P. श्यायति, to cause to congeal or freeze, ŚBr.;
 (Ā.) श्यायते (Gr. also pf. शश्ये; aor. अश्यास्त; fut. श्याता, श्यास्यते),
to go, move, Dhātup. xxii, 67 :
Pass. शीयते, to congeal, freeze, be cold, TS.; TBr. :
Caus. श्यापयति Gr.:
Desid. शिश्यासते, ib. :
Intens. शाश्यायते, शाश्येति, शाश्याति, ib.
